questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Foundations of AI, Intelligent Agents & Environment Types
questions.text: Define Artificial Intelligence. Explain the Turing Test and Chinese Room Argument. Explain Rational Agents and the PEAS (Performance Measure, Environment, Actuators, Sensors) framework for: (a) Automated Taxi Driver, and (b) Medical Diagnosis System.

questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Foundations of AI, Intelligent Agents & Environment Types
questions.text: Explain Environment Types in AI: Fully Observable vs Partially Observable, Deterministic vs Stochastic, Episodic vs Sequential, Static vs Dynamic, Discrete vs Continuous, and Single-Agent vs Multi-Agent. Classify Agent Architectures: Simple Reflex, Model-Based, Goal-Based, and Utility-Based agents.

Compare Uninformed Search Algorithms: Breadth-First Search (BFS), Depth-First Search (DFS), Uniform-Cost Search (UCS / Dijkstra), Depth-Limited Search (DLS), and Iterative Deepening DFS (IDDFS) in terms of Completeness, Time Complexity, Space Complexity, and Optimality.

Explain $A^*$ Search Algorithm ($f(n) = g(n) + h(n)$). Define Admissible Heuristic ($h(n) \le h^*(n)$) and Consistent (Monotonic) Heuristic ($h(n) \le c(n, a, n') + h(n')$). Prove that: (a) Tree-search $A^*$ is optimal if $h(n)$ is admissible, and (b) Graph-search $A^*$ is optimal if $h(n)$ is consistent.

Solve the 8-Puzzle Problem from initial state to goal state using $A^*$ search with: (1) Misplaced Tiles heuristic $h_1(n)$, and (2) Manhattan Distance heuristic $h_2(n)$. Why is $h_2$ dominant over $h_1$?

Explain the Minimax Algorithm for two-player zero-sum perfect information games. Trace the Minimax algorithm and Alpha-Beta Pruning on a given 4-ply game tree with 16 terminal leaf utility values. List all branch cuts / pruned nodes and state conditions for $\alpha$-cutoff and $\beta$-cutoff ($\alpha \ge \beta$).

Explain Constraint Satisfaction Problems (CSP). Formalize the 8-Queens Problem and Map Coloring Problem (Australia map with 7 regions using 3 colors Red, Green, Blue) as CSPs. Explain Backtracking Search with MRV (Minimum Remaining Values) heuristic, Degree heuristic, Least Constraining Value heuristic, and Forward Checking / AC-3 Arc Consistency algorithm.

Translate the English statements into First-Order Predicate Logic (FOPL):
(a) "Every student in IOE likes computer programming."
(b) "Anyone who is a father of someone is older than that person."
(c) "Only one student scored $100\%$ in AI exam."
(d) "Politicians can fool some people all the time, and all people some of the time, but not all people all the time."

Explain the steps to convert First-Order Logic formulas into Conjunctive Normal Form (CNF / Clause Form): Eliminate implications, Move negations inward (De Morgan's), Standardize variables, Skolemization ($f(x)$ for existential quantifiers), Drop universal quantifiers, and Distribute $\lor$ over $\land$.

Explain Resolution Refutation theorem proving in First-Order Logic with Unification and Most General Unifier (MGU). Given the facts:
1. Marcus was a man.
2. Marcus was a Pompeian.
3. All Pompeians were Romans.
4. Caesar was a ruler.
5. All Romans were either loyal to Caesar or hated him.
6. Everyone is loyal to someone.
7. People only try to assassinate rulers they are not loyal to.
8. Marcus tried to assassinate Caesar.
Prove that "Marcus hated Caesar" using resolution refutation.

Explain Supervised, Unsupervised, and Reinforcement Learning paradigms. Explain Decision Tree learning using ID3 algorithm with Information Gain and Entropy ($H(S) = -\sum p_i \log_2 p_i$). Calculate information gain for a dataset of weather attributes predicting whether to play tennis.

questions.chapter: Chapter 6: Machine Learning, Neural Networks & Natural Language Processing
questions.text: Explain the McCulloch-Pitts Neuron model and Perceptron Learning Rule. Why can a single-layer perceptron not learn the XOR function (Linear separability limitation)? Explain Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) and derive the Backpropagation Gradient Descent weight update equation.

Explain the phases of Natural Language Processing (NLP): Lexical/Morphological Analysis, Syntactic Parsing (Context-Free Grammars & Parse Trees), Semantic Analysis, Pragmatic/Discourse Processing. Explain Expert Systems architecture (Inference Engine, Knowledge Base, Explanation Facility).

Explain Local Search Algorithms: Simple Hill Climbing, Steepest-Ascent Hill Climbing, and problems encountered (Local Maxima, Ridges, Plateau / Shoulder). Explain Simulated Annealing ($P(\Delta E) = e^{\Delta E / T}$) and Genetic Algorithms (Selection, Crossover, Mutation).
Compare Forward Chaining vs. Backward Chaining in production rule systems. Explain Semantic Networks, Frames (Slot-and-filler representation), and Conceptual Dependency.

questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Foundations of AI, Intelligent Agents & Environment Types
questions.text: Explain Naive Bayes Classifier using Bayes' Theorem: $P(c|x) = \frac{P(x|c)P(c)}{P(x)}$. Classify a text document as Spam or Not Spam given word token conditional probabilities with Laplace smoothing.
